text: Figure 3.44: ArbitraryEventTriggering Class ArbitraryEventTriggering Note Describes that an event occurs occasionally , singly , irregularly or randomly . The primary purpose of this event triggering is to abstract event occurrences captured by data acquisition tools (background debugger, trace analyzer, etc.) during system runtime.
